stem: Based on the information in paragraph 4, which inference can the reader make about flavor preferences?

options.label: A
options.text: Parents of toddlers are more likely to try new foods than people with older children are.

options.label: B
options.text: Toddlers tend to like more foods than older children do.

options.label: C
options.text: People can begin to enjoy new foods after trying them just once.

options.label: D
options.text: People can learn to like new foods at different times in their lives.
